title: Zanzibar Guide 2026: Beaches, Spice Island & Safari Extensions
meta_title: Zanzibar Guide 2026 | Beaches, Spice Tours & Safari Extensions
meta_description: Plan Zanzibar after your Tanzania safari: best beaches (Kendwa, Nungwi, Paje), Stone Town, spice tours, Jozani, costs, and how to combine with Serengeti from Arusha.
excerpt: A practical Zanzibar guide for safari travellers — best beaches, Stone Town, spice tours, marine life, costs, and how to add the Spice Island after Serengeti or Ngorongoro.

faqs.q: How many days should I spend in Zanzibar after a safari?
faqs.a: Most guests do well with 3–5 beach nights after a northern-circuit safari. Honeymooners and first-time visitors often prefer 5–7 nights so they can mix Stone Town, a spice tour, and a quieter beach stretch.

faqs.q: What is the best beach area in Zanzibar?
faqs.a: Nungwi and Kendwa suit swimming and sunsets on the north coast; Paje and the southeast excel for kitesurfing and a more relaxed vibe. Our Team matches the coast to your season, tide comfort, and hotel style.

faqs.q: Can I combine Serengeti with Zanzibar?
faqs.a: Yes — it is our most requested “complete Tanzania” formula. Finish game drives in Serengeti or Ngorongoro, then fly via Arusha or Kilimanjaro to Zanzibar for beach recovery days.

faqs.q: When is the best time to visit Zanzibar?
faqs.a: Dry months (roughly June–October and January–February) are popular for beach days. Shoulder periods can mean softer rates. Pair timing with our best-time Tanzania guide if you are also chasing the Great Migration.
